## Triage: first grade, `security` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:access` · `pm:queue`. Direction: executes the maintainer's ruling A on objectstack-ai/cloud#1765, as written

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T08:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-security` (beside `position-catalog-refusal.ts`) ⇒ `domain:services`; rationale: plugin-security is that lane's (`lanes/services.md:10`).

- **Why `security`, and why p2:** a cross-organization grant can be staged and later activates with no further grant. Only a platform admin was measured able to write it, so it is not p1. ⛔ Keep follow-ups abstract: classes, positions, files and functions.
- **The ruling is the direction:** refuse at write for every non-system caller, with the existing 400 envelope and no new code. System writes stand down. ⛔ B and C are not taken.
- **Clause-②: no**, a pure refusal (narrowing).

Claim: PM loop round 3 · 2026-10-08T09:16Z
Session: `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`
Account: `os-bill` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22226-position-holder-membership`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22226`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#1` (seat post #6021)
⛔ Classes, positions and functions only.

**Executes the maintainer's ruling A** on objectstack-ai/cloud#1765 (`6053780796`), as the card body and triage `6056395052` state it.

File surface at `origin/main` `73a0a6bf`:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-catalog-refusal.ts`: the existing middleware for `sys_user_position` (`createPositionCatalogRefusal`). A non-system insert or update whose `user_id` has no `sys_member` row in the row's `organization_id` is refused. The answer is the existing `400` `VALIDATION_FAILED` envelope with `fields[].code: reference_not_found`; there is no new code. System writes stand down, as the sibling refusal does.
  - If a module of its own is cleaner, it sits beside that file. Its one wiring line goes next to the existing one in `security-plugin.ts` (near `:4386`), at region level: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21908's deny round (this seat) edits other regions of that file.
- **The sibling junction, measured in this round:** `sys_user_permission_set` (`user_id` × `organization_id`; a NULL organization applies everywhere). It is folded in only if it measures the same class; otherwise the report records why not.
- Tests in `plugin-security`, per the card's list, plus one `@objectstack/plugin-security` changeset.
  - The refused writes assert `status`, `code` and `fields[0].code`, and the row is absent.
  - The positive control: a member succeeds.
  - An update that moves `user_id` to a non-member is refused.
  - A system write is not refused.

- Seat append, 2026-10-08T11:19Z, from the dev report's `deviations[0]` and PR #22275's Acceptance notes:
  - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: row 23d plus the regenerated census counts. `check:system-context-census` requires one row per `isSystem` read site, and the ruled system-write stand-down is two new reads.
  - The two sibling suites' harnesses (`position-catalog-refusal.test.ts`, `grant-permission-set-name.test.ts`) now provision `sys_member`, because the membership read fails closed.
Exclusions:
- ⛔ No picker change (B).
- ⛔ No RLS change.
- ⛔ No `packages/spec`.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; default tier, a `security` card)
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
- A non-system write that used to land is refused. That is declared breaking, with an ADR-0087 disposition. Nothing widens.
Responsibility: `this repository's own code: plugin-security checks a sys_user_position user_id for existence only, not for membership in the row's organization | none: the organization wall refuses only an explicit foreign organization stamp | the platform admin, measured able to stage a dormant cross-organization position grant (objectstack-ai/cloud#1765)`
Thread-read: 6056395052
Serial constraints cleared:
- Of the 14 open PRs (each file list read), none touches `position-catalog-refusal.ts` or `security-plugin.ts`.
- PR #22243 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22201, this seat, in the merge queue) edits `sys-user-position.object.ts` and `delegated-admin-gate.ts`. This claim edits neither.
